```rust
fn moved() -> impl Iterator<Item = u32> {
    let mut x = "foo".to_string();
    gen move {
        yield 42;
        if x == "foo" {
            return;
        }
        x.clear();
        for x in 3..6 {
            yield x
        }
    }
}
```
